Title: [DIR-EP01] Project Foundation & Architecture
Label: type:epic,area:devops,priority:P1
Body: Establish clean monorepo formatting, real ESLint enforcement, LF line-ending hygiene, unified AdminRoleType enum, and OpenAPI 1:1 contract parity.

Title: [DIR-EP02] Authentication & Account Management
Label: type:epic,area:backend,area:security,priority:P0
Body: Deliver production Supabase Auth OTP, Redis-backed rate limiting & token revocation, mobile 401 refresh interceptor, and DPDP account deletion.

Title: [DIR-EP03] Anonymous Identity & Privacy
Label: type:epic,area:backend,area:security,priority:P0
Body: Enforce 18+ ageVerified guard on write endpoints, fix concurrent Anonymous #XXXX collision risk, and eliminate author_user_id leaks.

Title: [DIR-EP04] Location & Geospatial Services
Label: type:epic,area:backend,area:database,priority:P0
Body: Implement PostGIS spatial queries and h3-js coarse geo-cells, enforce k-anonymity >= 20 threshold, and wire mobile location APIs.

Title: [DIR-EP05] Communities
Label: type:epic,area:mobile,area:admin,priority:P1
Body: Replace hardcoded city-* community fallbacks with real backend UUIDs and add admin community creation endpoint.

Title: [DIR-EP06] Posts & Content Management
Label: type:epic,area:backend,area:mobile,priority:P0
Body: Fix profile authored/saved endpoints, enforce Prisma $transaction atomicity, add S3 PostMedia uploads, Polls UI, and self-delete UI.

Title: [DIR-EP07] Comments & Reactions
Label: type:epic,area:backend,area:mobile,priority:P1
Body: Enforce block-filtered Socket.IO room broadcasts, restrict WS CORS, and scale real-time threads with @socket.io/redis-adapter.

Title: [DIR-EP08] Nearby Feed & Discovery
Label: type:epic,area:backend,area:mobile,priority:P0
Body: Fix mobile category feed routing, cursor (createdAt, id) tie-breaker pagination, trending cursor, infinite scroll, and server search.

Title: [DIR-EP09] Notifications
Label: type:epic,area:backend,area:mobile,priority:P0
Body: Fix mobile PATCH mark-read contract mismatch, integrate FCM/APNs push delivery, and wire live notification socket updates.

Title: [DIR-EP10] Safety, Reporting & Blocking
Label: type:epic,area:backend,area:mobile,area:security,priority:P0
Body: Enable anonymous-safe author blocking from posts/comments, verify appeal ownership, and build Mobile Moderation Appeals UI.

Title: [DIR-EP11] Moderation & Admin Dashboard
Label: type:epic,area:admin,area:backend,area:security,priority:P0
Body: Align Admin API client to live /v1/admin/* endpoints, strip reporter_id, enforce AdminRole expiresAt, upgrade Hinglish moderation, and add SSR HttpOnly auth.

Title: [DIR-EP12] Security & Privacy Compliance
Label: type:epic,area:security,area:backend,priority:P0
Body: Fail-closed JWT_SECRET validation, strict per-route throttling & CORS hardening, and DPDP Act privacy/SOP compliance docs.

Title: [DIR-EP13] Testing & Quality Assurance
Label: type:epic,area:qa,priority:P0
Body: Add real PostgreSQL/PostGIS/Redis integration tests, Admin Playwright tests, Mobile screen integration tests, Maestro E2E, and k6 load tests.

Title: [DIR-EP14] CI/CD & Infrastructure
Label: type:epic,area:devops,priority:P0
Body: Run real Postgres migrations/tests and format:check in CI, add Sentry/OpenTelemetry observability, Terraform AWS IaC, and gated deploy-production.yml.

Title: [DIR-EP15] Production Release & Operations
Label: type:epic,area:devops,area:security,priority:P0
Body: Complete security pen checklist, RDS PITR DR drill, EAS mobile builds & soak test, incident runbooks, and Release 1.0 Go/No-Go.
